processingPurpose: Provide and improve HireNudge services for Indian users.
obligation: Map applicable notice, consent/legitimate-use, rights, security, breach, processor and deletion duties against the Act and commenced Rules.
productControl: Purpose-specific notice, consent ledger, rights workflow, minimisation and deletion.
releaseGate: Legal review of the actual data map and implementation before claiming compliance.
limitation: Commencement and rule-specific obligations must be checked against current official notifications.

applicableModules: All services offered to or monitoring people in the EEA
obligation: Document roles, lawful bases, transparency, data-subject rights, minimisation, security, processors and transfers.
productControl: Data inventory, Article 13/14 notices where applicable, rights tooling, DPA and transfer controls.
releaseGate: Counsel confirms applicability and implemented controls for the chosen corridor.
limitation: Applicability depends on establishment, offering and monitoring facts; this is not a compliance conclusion.

obligation: Apply the recipient-country electronic-marketing rules in addition to GDPR.
productControl: Country classification, sender identity, opt-out, suppression and conservative sequencing.
releaseGate: Approve the initial recipient-country matrix before sending.
limitation: Implemented through national laws; one global rule is insufficient.

obligation: Classify corporate versus individual subscribers and apply transparency, objection and PECR rules.
productControl: Recipient classification, LIA where used, clear identity and suppression.
releaseGate: UK use case approved before launch.
limitation: B2B context does not remove all privacy and direct-marketing duties.

obligation: Use accurate headers/subjects, identify the sender, include required address/opt-out and honor suppression.
productControl: Message classification, footer controls, unsubscribe and suppression SLA.
releaseGate: US commercial-message template and suppression test pass.
limitation: Message classification and other federal/state rules require counsel.

processingPurpose: Commercial electronic messages to recipients in Canada.
obligation: Assess consent, identification, unsubscribe and recordkeeping requirements before sending.
productControl: Block Canada until an approved consent/use-case rule exists.
releaseGate: Canadian use case and evidence records approved.
limitation: CASL analysis is fact-specific and can be stricter than US rules.

regime: Google OAuth and API Services User Data Policy
processingPurpose: Send or sync user-authorised email actions.
obligation: Use minimum scopes, accurate consent, verification where required, secure storage and revocation/deletion.
productControl: gmail.send-first boundary, review screen, encrypted token vault and disconnect test.
releaseGate: Actual scopes, token architecture, verification and revoke/delete tests approved.
limitation: The published HireNudge policy does not prove the current OAuth implementation.

processingPurpose: User-invoked autofill, tracker save and profile optimisation.
obligation: Request the narrowest permissions, accurately disclose behavior and limit use to the stated single purpose.
productControl: Permission audit, supported-site tests, explicit invocation and no auto-submit.
releaseGate: Manifest, disclosure and runtime behavior reconcile with the privacy policy.
limitation: Policy text must be verified against the current extension manifest and code.

processingPurpose: Operate the product while respecting user control.
obligation: Define purpose-specific retention and operational deletion/export workflows.
productControl: Retention matrix, in-product deletion/export, provider propagation and closure evidence.
releaseGate: Deletion/export and token/provider propagation tests pass.
limitation: The policy uses general retention language; specific schedules and implementation evidence were not supplied.

dataInvolved: Career and application data processed across borders
processingPurpose: Use global infrastructure and service providers.
obligation: Identify data locations and apply the required transfer mechanism and safeguards.
productControl: Subprocessor/location register, transfer assessment and contractual safeguards.
releaseGate: Selected providers and corridors have an approved transfer map.
limitation: Requirements depend on controller roles, locations and providers.

obligation: Meet the agreed accessibility standard and applicable disability-law requirements for target markets.
productControl: Keyboard, focus, contrast, reflow, labels, reduced motion and assistive-technology QA.
releaseGate: Critical flows pass automated and manual accessibility tests.
limitation: WCAG conformance requires live testing; screenshots only identify risks.
